problem: The repository is now public, but GitHub's default branch main is a strict ancestor of the product branch and is 630 commits behind. Public landing pages, default code search, and default pull-request targets therefore expose the obsolete 2026-11-17 product state. Fast-forwarding main is safe because private/neko-overlay-v1 is a pure descendant, but main must run the same machine gate so it cannot become a bypass path.

selected.strategy: Fast-forward main to the same already-green product commit after the trigger change itself passes the product gate.
selected.workflow: Reuse .github/workflows/private-overlay-gate.yml and add main to the existing push and pull_request branch lists.
selected.product_authority: private/neko-overlay-v1 remains the canonical product-development branch; main is the public default mirror.

rejected: create a separate public mirror workflow
copy product files into main without shared ancestry
move development authority away from private/neko-overlay-v1 during active agent work
acceptance: main is a fast-forward only; no history rewrite
main and private/neko-overlay-v1 point to the same green commit at mirror time
push and pull_request events targeting main execute the same reuse/architecture/secret/product gate
agent freshness continues to use private/neko-overlay-v1 as product authority
future product releases may fast-forward main again only after the product head is green
retirement_condition: Retire the mirror policy if GitHub's default branch is changed to private/neko-overlay-v1 or the product branch is intentionally renamed/promoted to main with equivalent machine gates.
